scope_guards: Absence from the Ancient Woodland Inventory is not treated as proof that woodland is not ancient.
An inventory polygon is not accepted without current dataset version and exact spatial relation.
Planning permission is not treated as a felling licence in every circumstance.
A felling-licence exemption is not treated as exemption from TPO, conservation-area, SSSI or wildlife controls.
Compensation is not treated as replacing the wholly-exceptional-reasons test.
A buffer distance alone is not treated as impact avoidance.
New planting is not treated as equivalent replacement for an irreplaceable habitat.
No score or promotion is written without exact boundary, field evidence, consultations, consents, protection design and secured long-term management.
